title: Lilly inks $345M antibody development pact with XtalPi subsidiary

title: Using the Expected Move to Set Strike for Covered Call?
summary: Quick question for those who use the Expected Move indicator to see the market's expectation to the upside and downside. Is there any case study or backtest that shows how accurate it is?The Expected Move is the amount that a stock or index is expected to move up or down from its current price in any given timeframe, as derived from option prices.The Expected Move might also be viewed as the consensus of the options trading crowd. A projection of how much the market thinks a stock may move based on expectations of risk (volatility) over a given timeframe.For example, I'm looking at the expected move for $SHOP option chain (expiration is 12/19). To the upside is $161 and to the downside is $122. Based on that, I will sell a covered call at the $170 strike, assuming that it will expire worthless.I don't use this indicator often, so I'm wondering if that's the right utility or not.Example screenshotsubmitted by/u/alkjdasoad[link][comments]

title: I hate talking markets
summary: I am a trader and have started telling people “I’m a stock trader” when they ask what I do because I do make a vast majority of my income from trading and I believe if you put things into the world you manifest them. I don’t want to diminish the success I have had by lying.Anyway, it’s fucking horrible because people then interject with their question of the day. Or they ask what I think about this or that stock or about Trump and the markets.Now, I love talking the markets but I talk so far over their head it’s painful. They want seemingly a real answer and when I give them a real answer it’s just too nuanced, too open and too flexible.There are no concrete answers in trading. No concrete answers in where the market is going in 12 months. So then it feels like they think I’m lying and not just ruins the conversation.Maybe someone has a good answer to these questions that are more fun than technical? Because I’m highly technical and just want to talk shop.submitted by/u/illcrx[link][comments]
